text:
maya: deploy-bot flagged an embeddings p95 regression in canary after the 02:00 UTC cutover. Suggesting a microrollback for the canary slice. Can we decide quick? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Alert: canary embeddings p95 420ms -> 980ms, error rate +0.6%. Suggested action: targeted rollback of model artifact emb-v2.11.3 -> emb-v2.11.2 for canary slice. Confidence: medium.

samir: which pool is affected? is this eu or global?

maya: eu-dedicated embeddings pool (eu-embeds-pool-2) — only canary traffic, not prod split.

julie: ops / oncall, can someone run a targeted rollback to canary and watch for 30m? I can update release notes and status if we flip.

ops: I can take it. prefer targeted fallback to avoid full revert. Will run the microrollback and monitor charts. @oncall-bot FYI.

maya: deploy-bot, exact revert CLI?

deploy-bot: Suggested command:

```
redwoodctl rollout revert --model emb-v2.11.3 --to emb-v2.11.2 --scope=canary --percent=100
```

deploy-bot: Additional note: automatic rollforward suppressed if pin applied.

samir: 100% of canary slice is fine, we just need to avoid touching prod pools. Confirm scope includes only eu-embeds-pool-2.

ops: executing now. running:

```
redwoodctl rollout revert --model emb-v2.11.3 --to emb-v2.11.2 --scope=pool:eu-embeds-pool-2
```

ops: command returned: success -> rollout started at 1729990105. Old revision restored for canary pods.

oncall-bot: Reminder: change window open 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pager oncall as needed.

julie: drafting release note blurb: 'Reverted embeddings model to v2.11.2 for canary after p95 latency regression observed in canary slice. Monitoring ongoing, no impact to production observed.' Will post to #status if we promote.

maya: after rollback, let's verify p95 and QA eval. Samir will run the eval set and share. Ops to observe error budget and token throughput.

samir: running eval harness now against v2.11.2 on canary pool. Will paste results in ~15m.

ops: rollback completed at 1729990200. canary pool eu-embeds-pool-2 now serving emb-v2.11.2. immediate metrics: p95 dropped to ~380ms, error rate back to baseline. Charts: short link https://dash.redwood/embeds/canary?ts=1729990200 :thumbsup:

maya: good. I'll pin the rollback to prevent accidental rollforward for an hour.

ops: pin command run:

```
redwoodctl pin release --model emb --version v2.11.2 --scope=pool:eu-embeds-pool-2 --duration=1h
```

deploy-bot: Pin applied by ops. Auto-rollforward suppressed until 1h expiry. Created task INC-2023-784 for postmortem capture.

julie: ops, do we need to notify any dedicated customers in eu? small customer set on that pool.

ops: yes — will message account leads. Notifying now: "We performed a targeted fallback of embeddings model for your eu-dedicated pool as a precaution due to a latency regression in canary. No customer-facing errors detected. We'll follow up after 1h monitoring."

maya: thanks. Next steps: samir to validate eval results, ops to watch SLOs for 1h, julie to finalize status note and release notes entry. If stable after 1h, we'll leave pin until end of change window and schedule a controlled re-release with more telemetry.

samir: eval results: quality unchanged, latency baseline restored. Posting artifacts: https://ci.redwood/evals/emb-v2.11.2/172999.

maya: great. closing here — small rollback executed and pinned, ops will handoff to weekday oncall for longer-term follow-up. :white_check_mark:
